newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up by 0.42 percent in lower trade, bourse sorces said.
The 31-share index closed at 492.70 from 490.62 on Monday.
Volume was 5.8 million dinars against 9.49 million dinars. Turnover on the first market was 1.92 million dinars.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing won 0.96 dinar to 32.96 dinars.
Arab Tunisian Bank gained 0.94 dinar to 31.68 dinars. UIB bank was up 0.38 dinar to 13.25. UBCI bank rose 0.3 dinar to 47.2.
Coke and beer bottler SFBT fell 0.6 dinar to 85.5 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia declined 0.48 dinar to 43.52. Airliner Tuinis Air was down 0.2 dinar to 19 dinars.
Trade was active on BIAT bank with 31,450 changing hands at the unchanged price of 34.98 dinars. ($= 1.07 dinars)
